evidence.why: Contains the complete callback and exact argument expressions.

facts.rationale: Preserves the supported flow while replacing the unsupported floor characterization with the exact conversion and noting the source-level self-assignment.
facts.value: Reads a BracketEntry from gobj->user_data and performs an x3 self-assignment. It computes connector_y as -(x10 + x18) when x2 is nonzero, otherwise -x10. For x3 values 0 through 3, it passes the entry and geometry (xC - (s32)(0.5f * x1C), -x10, x14, -x18, connector_y) to the corresponding bracket-line helper. The s32 conversion truncates toward zero for representable values; it is not an explicit floor operation.

evidence.why: Shows coordinate calculation before setup and the complete switch.
Establishes scale and raw line-width state changes.

facts.rationale: Corrects execution order and avoids assigning pixel units that the inspected setup helper does not establish.
facts.value: After retrieving the entry and computing the x2-dependent connector coordinate, the callback calls HSD_FogSet(NULL) and hsd_80391A04(1.0f, 1.0f, 1). The latter sets unit primitive scales and forwards raw line-width value 1 to HSD_StateSetLineWidth. It then dispatches x3 values 0, 1, 2, and 3 to distinct bracket-line helpers. Other values perform no geometry dispatch after common graphics setup.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes returning no value from never returning.
facts.value: Parameterless void-returning cleanup wrapper: void fn_8018EC7C(void). It calls mn_8022F0F0 with 0x1B and then 0x14 and returns normally; its outputs are delegated side effects.

facts.rationale: Preserves the six-parameter ABI while making the overriding selector and narrowing explicit.
facts.value: Signature: void(s32 display_id, s32 destination_selector, s32 primary_text_index, f32 x, f32 y, s32 secondary_text_index). Selector 255 forces GetNameText((u8)display_id) to the primary destination regardless of ID range. Otherwise IDs below 800 use saved-name lookup for selectors 0 or 1, 800-899 format the primary label, 900-998 format the secondary label, and IDs >=999 produce no submission.

evidence.why: Aliases, guards, arithmetic, terminators, and copies.

facts.rationale: The executable !=999 condition and pointer aliases take precedence over range comments.
facts.value: Selects template pointers using the saved-language predicate; the second family's two language entries alias the same storage. IDs below 800 copy GetNameText((u8)slot_id); 800-899 format slot_id-800; all IDs >=900 except 999 enter the second-family arithmetic using slot_id-900. ID 999 leaves dest unchanged. Suffixes write at offset 7 and terminate at offset 8 or 9. There is no upper-bound rejection, so inputs above the intended two-digit range are not general decimal formatting.
